viz.text: A 96% cache hit rate turned a potential **$19.8K** bill into **$3.2K** — prompt caching saved ~$16.5K over 30 days. (Sonnet pricing: $3/M in, $0.30/M cache read, $15/M out.)

sections.title: /time · where your time goes
sections.prompt: Where does my time actually go?

viz.text: The dead zone is **UTC 04–07** (near-zero) — consistent with sleep. Three active windows: UTC 12–15, 20–23, and 00–03. Not a 9-to-5 pattern — work clusters into morning, afternoon, and a late-evening push.

sections.source: 4 recent OpenStory sessions Jun 17–26 — 1130 tool calls total

rows: Sessions run 4–7 days each; context degrades and errors concentrate late in the run
Execution-first: ops, greps, curls dominate structured reads and edits
1.85:1 — editing nearly 2x as often as reading; risk of edits without full context
23 errors in one 7-day session; the other 3 were clean — pattern is session-age correlated
Subagents used rarely — research and exploration stay serial
1 compact across ~7 days; context rarely hits the hard limit

viz.text: #1 pattern: **sessions run multi-day** (4–7 days each). That is where errors appear and context quality silently drifts. Fix: close and restart a session when a concrete phase ends — don't carry one thread across days of varied work.

sections.title: /recall · find it again
sections.prompt: Find the last time I solved this — and exactly how.
sections.source: agent_search 'federation nats leaf deploy' — 5 matches; tool_journey on the top session (Jun 21–25)

items.label: Make sure we are connected to the hub

items: curl -s http://localhost:8222/varz | python3 -c "import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print('leafnodes:', d.get('leafnodes'))"
pkill -f 'nats-server -c nats.conf'   # free :4222 so the leaf node can bind it
curl -s http://localhost:8222/leafz   # out->hub / in<-hub message counts confirm the link
curl -s http://localhost:3002/api/sessions   # both hosts' sessions should now appear

viz.text: Topic recalled: **NATS leaf federation** — connecting local OpenStory to the distributed hub over Tailscale. Last solved Jun 25, 2026. Key insight: a standalone `nats.conf` occupies `:4222` and blocks the leaf node; `up-federation` sources `.env.federation` and starts the leaf instead.

sections.title: /scan · before you share
sections.prompt: Is there anything sensitive in my history?
sections.source: FTS5 search across live event store for 7 sensitive-pattern categories; baseline confirmed by dedicated /scan session (80b66f5f) which ran grep against the transcript tree

viz.text: All high-signal key prefixes are **zero** — confirmed clean. The 10 `password` hits are session-transcript context only: SSH login prompts from a server setup and dummy test-fixture credentials in a NATS multi-account test config — no real credentials. `Bearer`/`api_token` hits are Rust middleware source snippets read during code review, not live token values.
